summary: Preinstall hook fetches Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload unrelated to package purpose
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook that runs `node setup.mjs`. `setup.mjs` is obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0xNNNN` identifiers and string-dispatch maps hiding URLs, filenames, and subprocess arguments); it checks for a local `bun` binary and, if absent, downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from `github.com/oven-sh/bun` releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to run the sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a 727KB compiled/obfuscated Bun blob (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, rotated string array of hex constants, no readable source). The package's stated purpose is an AWS Lambda invocation helper, which does not require a second language runtime or an opaque bootstrap payload. The Bun runtime is fetched from its official project source, but the code executed under it is the package's own obfuscated `math_init.js` — an unreadable payload dispatched at install time via an alternate runtime that bypasses Node-based tracing. The unrelated `dist/*/utils/generate-api-gateway-event.js` file contains a benign `ping` string as an API Gateway event fixture and is not part of the install-time behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
